title: Phishing Click — Intern Workstation

fields.subject: FW: Urgent — Phishing Link Clicked on OPS_INTERN_03
fields.note:
Hey IT Lead, I just got a call from the security team. I accidentally clicked a link in a phishing email this morning while using the Ops workstation (OPS_INTERN_03). The email said 'Free Ironclads Tickets – Claim Your Seats Now!' and I thought it was a joke. Now they're saying I might’ve opened a backdoor. I’m really sorry. I didn’t realize it was bad.

I’ve locked the workstation and disconnected the network cable. Let me know what to do next.
fields.signature:
Jordan Miller
IT Intern
North Coast Regional Airport Authority

original.subject: You're Invited: Free Ironclads Tickets for October 23rd Game
original.body:
Hi Jordan,

Good news! Your free tickets to the Lakeport Ironclads vs. Rivermen game on October 23rd are ready.

Click here to claim your seat: https://tickets.ironclads-team.com/claim/ncia-2026-jm

Don’t miss out — tickets go fast!

Best,
Ironclads Ticketing Team

This is an automated message. Do not reply.

instructorNote: This inject reveals the attack vector. IT must isolate OPS_INTERN_03 and initiate forensic containment.

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Terminal Incident Response Plan (TIRP)
citations.headingPath: TIRP › Section 13 › 13.4 Scenario A: Ransomware / Critical Network Failure
citations.quote: **Impact:** airport computers locked; files encrypted; airline systems (separate networks) may be unaffected, but airport-provided systems (FIDS, BHS) fail. **Response:** IT — isolate the network; ord
